note: Macro conditions can influence Bitcoin but do not predict its price. No macro score is produced.
unavailable_policy: Missing data is represented as unavailable and is never converted to zero.

series.name: BTC macro regime
series.explanation: Correlations compare daily BTC returns with dollar strength, gold, and Nasdaq returns. Positive means they have tended to move together; negative means they have tended to move opposite.
series.source: Existing BTC daily history + FRED keyless series

series.name: Dollar exchange strength
series.explanation: Higher dollar exchange strength can tighten global liquidity for BTC.
series.source: FRED: Nominal Broad U.S. Dollar Index

series.name: CPI inflation
series.explanation: Higher consumer inflation can pressure policy rates and liquidity.

series.name: Dollar purchasing power
series.explanation: Calculated as 100 divided by CPI; this is separate from dollar exchange strength.

series.name: PCE/Core PCE
series.explanation: Core PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge.

series.name: Federal-funds rate
series.explanation: Higher policy rates usually make liquidity less supportive.

series.name: 2-year Treasury yield
series.explanation: The 2-year yield tracks expected near-term Fed policy.

series.name: 10-year Treasury yield
series.explanation: Higher long yields can pressure long-duration risk assets.

series.name: 10-year real yield
series.explanation: Higher inflation-adjusted yields can compete with scarce assets.

series.name: M2 money supply
series.explanation: Expanding money supply can support Bitcoin; contraction can work against it.

series.name: Federal Reserve assets
series.explanation: A larger Fed balance sheet can indicate easier liquidity conditions.

series.name: Reverse repo
series.explanation: Lower reverse repo balances can release cash into markets.

series.name: Nasdaq/risk appetite
series.explanation: A rising Nasdaq often signals stronger risk appetite.

series.name: VIX
series.explanation: Higher volatility usually means weaker risk appetite.

series.name: Unemployment
series.explanation: Rising unemployment can signal macro stress.

series.name: Gold
series.explanation: Gold is a parallel hard-asset reference, not a BTC signal.

series.name: Oil
series.explanation: Higher oil can feed inflation pressure.

series.name: Treasury General Account
series.explanation: A rising TGA can drain reserves; a falling TGA can add liquidity.

series.name: BTC supply/issuance
series.explanation: 403 Forbidden

series.name: BTC hash rate/difficulty
series.explanation: 403 Forbidden

series.name: BTC fees/activity
series.explanation: 403 Forbidden

series.name: Stablecoin supply
series.explanation: No approved keyless free broad stablecoin supply series is implemented; unavailable rather than substituted.

series.name: ETF flows
series.explanation: Uses the existing verified dashboard ETF snapshot; this does not alter scoring.

series.name: Futures/funding
series.explanation: Uses the existing verified dashboard futures/funding snapshot; this does not alter scoring.

btc_vs_gold.note: Gold market value and BTC supply change over time, so these targets move.
btc_vs_gold.source: Existing BTC dashboard data, Yahoo Finance public chart API, Blockchain.com totalbc, CompaniesMarketCap gold market cap
